identity.meaning: Nonblank leaf identity and primary SAN. The SAN parser accepts IPs or DNS text made of ASCII letters, digits, hyphen, asterisk, dot and underscore.

sans.meaning: Supplemental SAN names as an array of strings, comma-separated text, or iterable object keys. Trimmed names are deduplicated and classified as DNS or IP by the same parser.

ips.meaning: Supplemental SAN names as an array of strings, comma-separated text, or iterable object keys. Trimmed names are deduplicated and classified as DNS or IP by the same parser.

dry-run.meaning: Inspect the standing leaf or plan issuance without writing a key or certificate.

primitive.meaning: The certificate operation (issue_leaf), or error for the stop-level exception arm.

role.meaning: Normalized appliance profile used by the certificate operation.

changed.meaning: Whether the primitive reports a change; some failure paths may report partial effects.

dry_run.meaning: Whether the primitive returned a dry-run receipt; a refusal before planning can report false.

state_generation.meaning: Reported generation of the certificate state, or 0 when not available.

client_reinstall_required.meaning: Whether clients must reinstall trust for the reported operation.

sans.meaning: Observed standing SANs or the normalized requested DNS names and IP addresses.

ca_fingerprint.meaning: Root fingerprint, which can be null if dry-run only plans to create the root.

leaf_fingerprint.meaning: Leaf certificate fingerprint when a standing or newly signed leaf was read.

leaf_not_after.meaning: OpenSSL notAfter text for the verified leaf.

bundle_fingerprint.meaning: Fingerprint of the preserved Linux CA bundle, or null when absent.

bundle_preserved.meaning: The existing public CA bundle was not changed.

plan.meaning: Ordered action names describing the proposed operation.

proof.meaning: Evidence named by the primitive for this outcome.
